mismatch.message: unsupported hero command: an unported branch of this command: unsupported initial-level monster creation: makemon() monster 114

summary: At segment 0, zero-based step 19, #wizgenesis asks C makemon.c:makemon to create named monster 114 (a long worm) on the hero square. C enters the ordinary runtime relocation and worm initialization path. JavaScript stops first in its initial-level species preflight because PM_LONG_WORM is absent from assertSupportedSpecies’ named-species allowlist, before the translated makemon body can reach that C behavior.

source.branch: For an explicit runtime creation request at (u.ux,u.uy), when !gi.in_mklev and mdat is PM_LONG_WORM, makemon relocates the hero-square request through enexto_core (retrying without GP_CHECKSCARY only if needed), then creates the monster. At the PM_LONG_WORM tail arm it consumes a worm slot, initializes the worm with allowtail ? rn2(5) : 0, and calls place_worm_tail_randomly only when count_wsegs is nonzero. C has no corresponding species allowlist; JavaScript currently refuses the named create-particular species before these branches.
callers: C: wizcmds.c:wiz_genesis (203-210) calls read.c:create_particular (3372-3408), which reaches read.c:create_particular_creation (3252-3371) and calls makemon(whichpm,u.ux,u.uy,mmflags) at 3315; JS: js/wizcmds.js:wiz_genesis -> js/read.js:create_particular -> create_particular_creation -> makemon_runtime.

The selected recording uses #wizgenesis with the named hostile long worm; create_particular_creation consumes the returned monster pointer, stops the named-species loop on NULL, and otherwise continues with hostility/visibility/saddle handling.
dependencies: teleport.c:enexto_core (Boolean result plus output coordinates); the first C-only draw at the mismatch is rn2(8) from collect_coords at teleport.c:700, reached by makemon.c:1180-1182.
makemon.c:propagate (return is explicitly discarded at makemon.c:1233, but birth-state side effects still occur) and makemon.c:newmonhp (initializes hit points and consumes source RNG).

worm.c:get_wormno (returned slot number gates the entire long-worm tail branch); worm.c:initworm (void, initializes the segment chain); worm.c:count_wsegs (returned count gates tail placement); worm.c:place_worm_tail_randomly (void, places/truncates segments and redraws).
trap.c:rnd_nextto_goodpos is the consumed Boolean/output-coordinate helper called by worm.c:place_worm_tail_randomly for each segment placement; its false return truncates the remaining tail.

evidence: The exact v13 evaluation challenges/evaluations/20260929141337-v13.json at 35deeae3b45298577e919836bfad5c2da681ab6b reports 19/42 screens and cursors and 3721/3826 RNG calls. The first mismatch is the stop at zero-based segment 0 step 19 on newline: “unsupported initial-level monster creation: makemon() monster 114”; the first C-only RNG call is rn2(8)=7 @ collect_coords(teleport.c:700).

Upstream makemon.c:1157-1185 records byyou from the requested coordinates and, outside level generation, invokes enexto_core before construction. Lines 1405-1408 show the PM_LONG_WORM path: get_wormno return, initworm with the conditional rn2(5), then the count_wsegs return gates place_worm_tail_randomly.

The production source entry is wizcmds.c:wiz_genesis -> read.c:create_particular -> create_particular_creation -> makemon at read.c:3315. JavaScript preserves this route in js/wizcmds.js:wiz_genesis, js/read.js:create_particular_creation (3609-3612), and js/makemon_create.js:makemon_runtime.

The JavaScript refusal is in js/makemon_create.js:assertSupportedSpecies, called by preflightCreation at 1671. PM_LONG_WORM is absent from INITIAL_LEVEL_MONSTERS and the explicit create-particular exceptions, even though makemon translation already has a PM_LONG_WORM initialization branch (js/makemon_create.js:3322-3328). The first mismatch therefore precedes worm initialization: permit this source-supported runtime named-creation path, then verify the entire relocation and tail result against C.

The source inspection was confirmed in the clean merged A2 worktree at 8e51315368f217b55a83e02cc385b5fb25d2c7b3; the recorded v13 comparison and original queue provenance remain at evaluation commit 35deeae3b45298577e919836bfad5c2da681ab6b. The later dagger action reaches dothrow.c:thitmonst and worm.c:cutworm at step 41, so cutworm is downstream of and outside this first-mismatch scope.
